security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Keep several Claude accounts apart. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
bundle.longDescription: Facet keeps each of your Claude accounts in its own folders, starts the official Claude apps for the right account, and checks that accounts stay apart. Unofficial and not affiliated with Anthropic. Facet never reads or copies sign-in data and makes no network calls to Anthropic.
